learning_goal: Test whether teams document idea rationale and rejected options
minimum_test: Use template in three active decisions
success_signal: At least 80 percent of decisions include rationale and rejected alternatives

learning_goal: Test whether assumption mapping improves option evaluation
success_signal: Participants revise at least two option scores after assumption review

learning_goal: Test whether future scenarios alter option ranking
minimum_test: Compare baseline and three scenario scores
success_signal: At least one major ranking shift is explained and reviewed

learning_goal: Test whether rapid prototype evidence changes commitment level
minimum_test: Run two-week evidence sprint before funding decision
success_signal: Decision changes or is strengthened with explicit evidence

learning_goal: Test whether dashboard metrics support rather than distort judgment
minimum_test: Review candidate metrics for gaming and false precision
success_signal: At least two metrics are revised before launch

learning_goal: Test whether affected stakeholders identify hidden burdens
success_signal: Hidden burden or exclusion risk is documented and addressed

learning_goal: Test whether sequencing risks can be identified early
success_signal: Critical dependency risks are identified and assigned

learning_goal: Test whether feedback risks are visible before commitment
success_signal: At least one plausible unintended consequence changes implementation design

learning_goal: Test whether rejected options improve future review
minimum_test: Record rejected alternatives across two selection meetings
success_signal: Future review uses archived alternative or rationale

learning_goal: Test whether option classification improves portfolio balance
minimum_test: Classify active ideas by role horizon commitment and reversibility
success_signal: Portfolio review changes sequencing or resource allocation

learning_goal: Test whether explicit weighting improves legitimacy and clarity
minimum_test: Run criteria weighting before idea selection
success_signal: Participants identify tradeoffs and revise weights before scoring

learning_goal: Test whether feedback changes strategic assumptions
minimum_test: Run monthly learning-loop review for one initiative
success_signal: At least one assumption or strategic pathway is revised
